## Installation

1. Download and install [Max Payne 3 Fusion Fix](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/MaxPayne3.FusionFix#readme), or the required [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader).
2. Download [Fusion Rain Droplets for Max Payne 3](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/FusionRainDroplets/releases/download/maxpayne3/MaxPayne3.FusionRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` file into the `plugins` folder.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains, and snowflakes gather on the camera in the snowy chapters.

Used Xbox Rain Droplets before? Delete the old `MaxPayne3.XboxRainDroplets.asi`: while it is there, the game shows a message and closes.

## Notes

- Only a camera under the open sky gets wet: nothing lands on it indoors, under roofs and overhangs, inside vehicles, in the menus or during cutscenes, which also wipe the camera clean. In the pause menu the drops stay as they are.
- Change the settings on [fusionfix.io](https://fusionfix.io), in FusionFixHub, or in the game with Max Payne 3's Fusion Fix (its menu and the Ctrl+F10 overlay); changes apply while the game runs. They are stored in the `.cfg` next to the plugin.
